mapper.select: SELECT sc.id, sc.check_no, sc.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, sc.status, sc.remark, sc.operator_id, sc.operator_name, sc.created_at, sc.updated_at FROM stock_check sc LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = sc.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE sc.id = #{id} AND sc.deleted = 0
SELECT id, check_no, warehouse_id, status, remark, operator_id, operator_name, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_check WHERE check_no = #{checkNo} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_check (check_no, warehouse_id, status, remark, operator_id, operator_name) VALUES (#{checkNo}, #{warehouseId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName})
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_check SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
